profile.name: Mynul Islam
profile.tagline: I build fast, polished web products end to end — from pixel-perfect interfaces to resilient backends.
profile.availability: Open to full-time roles & freelance projects

about.currentStatus: Currently a Full Stack Developer shipping production features on a Next.js marketing + dashboard platform, and contributing to the design system that powers it.
about.bio: I'm a full stack developer focused on building delightful, performant web applications. I care about clean architecture, accessible interfaces, and motion that feels intentional. Over the last few years I've worked across commerce, SaaS dashboards, and creative tooling — owning features from concept through launch.
about.futureGoal: Grow into a staff-level engineer leading platform and developer-experience work, and ship an open-source product used by thousands of developers.

experience.currentProject: Leading the rebuild of a high-conversion marketing platform in Next.js 16, introducing a component-driven authoring workflow for the content team.
achievements: Rebuilt the marketing platform in Next.js, lifting Lighthouse performance from 62 to 98 and cutting editorial publish time by 40%.
Designed a reusable UI pattern library used across portfolio, commerce, and dashboard surfaces, unifying motion and accessibility defaults.
Solved a persistent hydration mismatch bug traced to client-only theme injection by moving theme resolution to a server-readable cookie, eliminating flaky render errors.
Partnered with design and product to ship polished features from concept through launch with strong accessibility defaults.
Built customer-facing SaaS workflows using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL for project planning and internal operations.
Created API integrations and dashboard tooling that reduced manual reporting work for operations teams by ~12 hours/week.
Fixed a recurring race condition in the notifications service by introducing an idempotency layer, removing duplicate alert bursts reported by users.
Introduced component documentation and deployment guardrails that improved release confidence across the team.
Delivered tailored websites and web apps for startups, agencies, and personal brands with a focus on storytelling and performance.
Scoped, designed, and implemented polished MVPs end to end, from wireframes to production deployment.
